name: Pump
fix_description: In _makeLiquidityPool, addLiquidity uses 0 minimum amounts. Fix: set reasonable minimum based on oracle price.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, repetitive exploit against multiple similarly vulnerable tokens using the same simple pattern: flash-borrow WBNB, abuse a flawed buyToken/liquidity flow, then dump tokens back to WBNB. It involves only a few straightforward external interactions and no deep protocol-specific reasoning, so a competent auditor could likely reproduce it quickly.
